delivery.title: Install the Apex CLI from the upstream repository
delivery.note: Installs uv and the `apex` command. Done once per machine, outside this repository.

delivery.title: Create a wallet and register its hotkey on netuid 1
delivery.note: Spends TAO (registration cost shown before confirming). Keys and mnemonics stay with the person and never enter this repository.

delivery.title: Link the registered hotkey to the Apex CLI
delivery.note: Writes .apex.config.json (hotkey file path) in the working directory; it is git-ignored and must not be committed.

delivery.title: Confirm the energy_arbitrage competition id, rules and submission fee
delivery.note: Authenticated with the hotkey. Also read https://docs.macrocosmos.ai/subnets/new-subnet-1-apex/subnet-1-base-miner-setup/current-competitions; check the competition still takes a Python policy(view, state) file.

delivery.title: Package the candidate after check and evaluate pass
delivery.note: Copies solution.py to tracks/main/dist/ with its sha256 and prints the exact submit command. Signs and pays nothing.

delivery.title: Submit the packaged solution (signs with the hotkey, pays the on-chain fee)
delivery.note: Winner-takes-all: the fee is lost unless this beats the current leader. If payment succeeds but upload fails, reuse --payment-block-hash/--payment-extrinsic-index instead of paying again.

delivery.title: Track the submission and leaderboard
delivery.note: Compare the live score with the local evaluate score and record the gap; `apex list -c <id> -t` shows the leaders.

settings.name: EA_SEED
settings.description: Master seed for local evaluate (instance seeds derive from it as in upstream test_challenge.py). Live seeds are hidden.

settings.name: EA_NUM_INSTANCES
settings.description: Instances scored by local evaluate; scenarios cycle BASELINE, CONGESTED, MULTIDAY, DENSE, CAPSTONE.

settings.name: EA_SANDBOX
settings.description: Run the candidate in the upstream subprocess sandbox during evaluate (true matches the live evaluator).
